items.text: kendo gouru milome e goda maler.
Ji duto modak e piny mondo otetni,
nikech odiechiengʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye biro.
En odiechiengʼ mar mudho kod kuyo,
kendo en odiechieng mar rumbi kod mudho mandiwa.
Ochalo gi piny moyawore ma lerne rieny e kor gode;
oganda mangʼongo kendo maratego mar jolweny biro,
kendo ok nochak one ndalo mabiro nyaka chiengʼ.
Piny chalo gi puoth Eden yo ka nyimgi
to ka bangʼ-gi piny otwo modongʼ nono,
Gilengʼore ewi gode gi koko machalo koko mag geche lweny,
kendo kaka mach makakni kawangʼo yugi,
kendo mana kaka oganda mar jolweny maroteke machanore ne lweny.
to gidhier nono kendo wengegi lil.
Ok gituomre, moro ka moro pangore
kendo gidonjo gie dirisni mana ka jokwoge.
"Kata sani, dwoguru ira gi chunyu duto,
ka uriyo kech kendo uywak kendo udengo."
Dwoguru ir Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu,
iye ok wangʼ piyo kendo ojahera,
bende chunye lendo kuom kelo ne ji masira kata chwat.
En ngʼa mongʼeyo? Onyalo lokore mi okechu
kendo ubed gi chiwo mag cham kod misengini
miolo piny muchiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasachu.
landuru lemo mar riyo kech maler,
Wuowi monyombo machiegni mondo owuogi oa e ode,
kendo miaha mondo owuogi oa kachiena.
Jodolo, matiyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye,
mondo oywagi, e kind agola gi
Kik imi girkeni mari obed gima ichayo,
Angʼo ma dimi giwachi e dier ogendini niya,
"Abiro miyou cham gi divai manyien kod mo zeituni,
"Anariemb jolweny moa nyandwat madhi mabor kodu,
joge motelo nodhi e nam man yo wuok chiengʼ,
to modongʼ nodhi e nam man yo podho chiengʼ.
adiera Jehova Nyasaye osetimo gik madongo.
Yaye le manie thim, weuru luor;
beduru moil kuom Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu,
koth mar chwiri e yo makare,
moriwo kodh chwiri kod kodh opon, mana kaka chon.
Kuonde dino cham nopongʼ gi cham;
kendo degi nopongʼ mi-oo oko gi divai manyien kod mo.
"Abiro chulou kuom higni ma bonyo osechamo;
gi bonyo mamoko gi mony mar bonyo;
ma gin oganda maduongʼ mar jolweny mara mane aoro e dieru.
Unubed gi chiemo mathoth, ma uchamo nyaka unuyiengʼ,
Wi joga ok nochak okuod kendo.
Eka unungʼe ni antie ei Israel,
ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu,
wi joga ok nochak okuod kendo."
anaol Roho Maler mara kuom ji duto.
Kata mana jotichna machwo gi mamon,
bende, naol Roho Maler mara kuomgi ndalono.
Anatim honni miwuoro e kor polo
remo gi mach kod iro madhwolore nobedie.
kapok odiechiengʼ maduongʼ kendo malich mar Jehova Nyasaye ochopo.
nikech ewi got Sayun kendo ei Jerusalem
